rules.title: No Console in Production
rules.check: console.log, console.error, console.warn are FORBIDDEN in production code. Use structured logging.
rules.rationale: Structured logging enables filtering, aggregation, and analysis in production systems.

rules.title: Structured Logging Format
rules.check: All logs MUST use structured JSON format with named properties, not string concatenation.
rules.bad_example:
logger.info(`User ${userId} created order ${orderId} for $${amount}`);
logger.error('Failed to process: ' + error.message);
rules.rationale: Structured logs are machine-parseable and enable powerful querying.

rules.title: Correlation ID in All Logs
rules.check: Every log entry MUST include correlation ID, request ID, or trace ID.
rules.bad_example:
logger.info('Processing request', { path: '/orders' });
// No correlation - can't trace across services
rules.rationale: Correlation IDs enable distributed tracing across services and requests.

rules.title: AsyncLocalStorage for Context
rules.check: Request context MUST use AsyncLocalStorage for automatic propagation across async boundaries.
rules.rationale: AsyncLocalStorage provides clean context propagation without parameter drilling.

rules.title: Log at All Exit Points
rules.check: Every function MUST log at entry (debug) and exit (info for success, error for failure).
rules.rationale: Entry/exit logging enables complete request tracing and performance analysis.

rules.title: OpenTelemetry Integration
rules.check: Distributed systems MUST use OpenTelemetry for tracing with proper span creation.
rules.rationale: OpenTelemetry provides vendor-neutral distributed tracing and observability.

rules.title: HTTP Client Tracing
rules.check: All outgoing HTTP requests MUST log duration, status, and propagate trace context.
rules.bad_example:
const response = await fetch('https://api.payment.com/charge');
// No logging, no tracing
rules.rationale: HTTP logging enables latency analysis and debugging of integration issues.

rules.title: Health Check Endpoints
rules.check: All services MUST expose /health/live and /health/ready endpoints.
rules.rationale: Separate liveness/readiness checks enable proper Kubernetes orchestration.

rules.title: Error Logging with Context
rules.check: All errors MUST be logged with full context including stack trace, cause chain, and identifiers.
rules.rationale: Rich error context enables effective debugging and postmortem analysis.

rules.title: Metrics Collection
rules.check: Key operations MUST emit metrics: counters for events, histograms for durations.
rules.rationale: Metrics enable alerting, capacity planning, and performance analysis.

rules.title: Startup Validation Logging
rules.check: Application startup MUST log configuration validation, dependencies, and metadata.
rules.rationale: Startup logging enables quick diagnosis of deployment issues.

rules.title: PII Redaction
rules.check: Logs MUST NOT contain PII, passwords, tokens, or other sensitive data.
rules.rationale: Logging PII creates compliance and security risks.

rules.title: No `console.log/error/warn` in production code
rules.check: FORBIDDEN: No `console.log/error/warn` in production code

rules.title: No string concatenation in log messages
rules.check: FORBIDDEN: No string concatenation in log messages

rules.title: No logs without correlation/request ID
rules.check: FORBIDDEN: No logs without correlation/request ID

rules.title: No sensitive data (passwords, tokens, PII) in logs
rules.check: FORBIDDEN: No sensitive data (passwords, tokens, PII) in logs

rules.title: No missing error logging in catch blocks
rules.check: FORBIDDEN: No missing error logging in catch blocks

rules.title: No missing health check endpoints
rules.check: FORBIDDEN: No missing health check endpoints

rules.title: No HTTP requests without duration logging
rules.check: FORBIDDEN: No HTTP requests without duration logging

rules.title: No startup without configuration validation logging
rules.check: FORBIDDEN: No startup without configuration validation logging

rules.title: No silent error swallowing
rules.check: FORBIDDEN: No silent error swallowing

rules.title: No unstructured log formats in production
rules.check: FORBIDDEN: No unstructured log formats in production
